_about: Sentences in the wiki's ARC combat tips that patches made stale. Each `find` is replaced by `replace` (empty drops it). Ingest prints a note when `find` is no longer in the page, so a wiki edit can retire a fix. Research: docs/research/2026-11-06/arcs.md in the app repo.

fixes.find: Deadline can also instantly defeat a Bastion when deployed near the canister.
fixes.replace: A Deadline planted at the core or canister can kill it or nearly kill it, but since 1.3.0 cut explosive damage on large ARC it isn't a sure kill, so bring a second.

fixes.find: It is also good to note that one well-placed Deadline near its canister will destroy it in one mine.
fixes.replace: A Deadline on its rear chassis does heavy damage, but since 1.3.0 one mine isn't a sure kill.

fixes.find: As of right now it seems to ALWAYS drop the igniter if destroyed properly.
fixes.replace: A clean kill usually drops the Igniter, but players report misses, so it isn't guaranteed.

fixes.find: Raiders can fully avoid the Hydra's bullet barrage by standing right in front in the middle of it between the two gun segments, as the gun segments will not be able to aim and fire at the Raider. However, this leaves you vulnerable to wind currents, other ARC or Raider gunfire.
fixes.replace: Standing between its two gun segments no longer keeps you safe: 2.2.0 fixed it struggling to hit close targets and raised its damage.

fixes.find: It can be easily destroyed with a single Hullcracker shot or destroyed with explosives like Seeker Grenades.
fixes.replace: A Hullcracker shot or explosives like Seeker Grenades hit it hard, though one Hullcracker shot may not finish it.

fixes.find: Dam Battleground - Electrical Substation for cover
fixes.source: Patch 1.7.0 (2025-12-16) moved its Dam Battlegrounds spawn

fixes.replace: Hold [interact] to dislodge the Tick, or dodge-roll to shake it off.

fixes.find: Using a Jupiter 150-200 meters away from the Turbine is an easy way of destroying it, as the lightning attack wont be able to reach you, and the Jupiter can pierce its heavy armor.
fixes.replace: The Jupiter can pierce its heavy armor, which makes it a good long-range option.
fixes.source: No source backs the lightning range; 1.27.0 changed its long-range visibility

fixes.find: especially when used during or just after the Shredder's charge animation.
fixes.replace: especially stuck to it during or just after its charge animation. Trigger 'Nade fuses are longer since 1.11.0, so stick it rather than air-burst it.
